## bijection_verdict
**PASS** (task 1). No affected document. First revision.

Policy-side / cross-product notes (not KB verdicts): (1) the expedited <- external-review edge is an action-form edge with a declared fallback; the KB carries it verbatim in action form, as required. (2) The source's "external effectuation hours" and "lets an expedited external review run alongside the internal appeal" are rendered in the appeal corpus as "Coverage in effect after an external overturn (hours)" and "An urgent case may go to expedited external review while the urgent internal appeal is pending"; bridgeable, and outside this skill's verdict range. (3) Base `formulary_external_exception_review` sends an overturned approval to "the period formulary_evt_exception_duration sets", whose standard/expedited length clauses are retired by the extended policies; the KB mirrors this faithfully ("for the period the approval-term rules set"); whether that period is defined for overturns is a policy-side question not exercised by this task.
